corpus: methanol-synthesis historical corpus, frozen for SCALE curation; scoped to methanol synthesis from CO/CO2 + H2 (CO + D2 included).

cutoff.caution: The cutoff does not remove every Cu-Zn-Al disclosure: the corpus leakage audit of the earlier curation lists US 2,061,470 (Larson, granted 1936), whose Example 10 is 87 CuO / 10 ZnO / 3 Al2O3, and Cu-Zn catalysts from 1928 on. They are in scope and curated as reported; a rediscovery evaluation must hold them out separately if it needs to.
cutoff.patents: grant (publication) date printed on the patent, not the priority or filing date
cutoff.why: ICI launched low-pressure methanol synthesis over Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 in 1966 (GB 1,010,871, published 1966; US 3,326,956); a cutoff of 1 January 1966 holds out that commercialization and what followed as rediscovery targets, and admits everything published before it, ICI's earlier publications included.

pdfs: Not in the repository (most are in copyright): pdfs/<slug>.pdf for each in-scope source, copied from the project corpus (<corpus>/<corpus_pdf>), its sha256 equal to text.pdf_sha256; git-ignored. A slug is the DOI with / as - (a patent or report without a DOI: its number or hid). The public-domain sources' PDFs are in examples/methanol-synthesis-public/pdfs/.
